basic_info.description:
Lovely, light-filled 2BR house with new kitchen, new bathroom, and fresh paint. The house has a large foyer, living room & dining room. It also has two generously sized bedrooms in the back of the house, overlooking the large backyard with a future patio & landscaping to be built in July. There is a driveway and a full size basement with parking for 2 cars and a ton of storage space. The kitchen has a dishwasher, and clothes washer & drier are in the basement. Small dog is negotiable.

The house is in a fantastic location: 
* 2 blocks to restaurants and businesses on West Portal Ave
* Short walk to Safeway & restaurants on Taraval St.
* 5 minute walk to West Portal Muni Station & other transportation options.
* Short drive to highway 280
* Walk to the beach, and close to Golden Gate Park

Tenants responsible for all utilities.
Last month rent + security deposit required to move in.
No smokers please.
